limits: No owner playtest or overall high-end/AAA fidelity acceptance.
Silent scripted motion studies do not validate ordinary native controls, audio, fairness, saves or performance; these were not repeated for the animation-only change.
Fixed30Hz capture is not hardware frame-rate evidence and does not cover variable-frame-rate or all terrain/attack directions.
Sixteen-bone procedural rigs have no individual finger/toe articulation, facial rig, ragdoll or additional runtime LOD. Deep bends compress inner knees and extreme reaches can overlap leafy surfaces.
Dark/overlapping limbs and perspective limit tiny contact/deformation judgment; Boss Front corpse nose approaches the lower frame edge.

The isolated player-view study leaves its introductory tutorial banner/zero-threat HUD active. The banner and folded weapon obscure portions of the closest raised/descending claw; ordinary ward-combat overlap was not established.
